faqs.question: What is natural language processing?
faqs.answer: Natural language processing is a field of AI that helps software work with human language, including text and speech, for tasks such as classification, search, extraction, translation, and summarization.

faqs.question: What can NLP development services help businesses do?
faqs.answer: NLP can organize documents, analyze conversations and feedback, extract information, improve search, summarize content, and support multilingual customer experiences.

faqs.question: What is the difference between NLP and generative AI?
faqs.answer: NLP is a broad set of methods for processing and understanding language. Generative AI focuses on creating new content. Modern systems can combine NLP tasks with generative models and retrieval.

faqs.question: Can NLP work with our business documents and data?
faqs.answer: Yes. NLP solutions can process approved documents, messages, records, and knowledge sources, with access and privacy controls designed for your environment.

faqs.question: Can NLP systems support multiple languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Depending on the use case and data, NLP systems can identify languages, translate content, and support multilingual search and conversations.

faqs.question: How do you measure NLP model quality?
faqs.answer: We evaluate models against representative examples using metrics suited to the task, along with human review, error analysis, and real-world performance monitoring.

faqs.question: Can an NLP solution integrate with existing applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. NLP features can be exposed through APIs or integrated into websites, mobile apps, CRM platforms, search tools, and internal workflows.

faqs.question: How do you protect sensitive language data?
faqs.answer: We plan data handling around permissions, privacy, encryption, retention, and deployment requirements, and can keep processing within your approved environment.

faqs.question: How long does NLP development take?
faqs.answer: A focused proof of concept may take several weeks. Production delivery depends on data preparation, language coverage, integrations, evaluation, and compliance needs.

faqs.question: Do you support NLP systems after deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing support can include model monitoring, data updates, quality evaluation, security maintenance, and continuous improvements.
